messages:
Omar Khan: Quick brainstorm: planning a launch post + tiny interactive prompt demo embedded in the blog. tie it to a multi-level credit ladder (10 / 40 / 200) to test marginal lift by credit size. want to measure RSVP -> demo-run -> first-5 -> paid within 14 days.
Sofia Li: love the interactive demo idea. embed should let users run one short prompt inline (no signup) then require claim to continue. that will give a clean upstream conversion signal.
Becky Nguyen: routing question: where do claimers go? propose: enterprise domains -> SF lead + tag "launch-interactive", else -> growth inbox + add to 7-day nurture.
Devon Park: +1. also add a web-hook to #growth-live on claim with payload (email_domain, credit_tier, campaign). can ops flip a flag on for a fast model path for claim traffic? low latency improves demo completion.
mkt-bot: note: feature-flag "interactive-demo_fastpath" created (default off).
Omar Khan: good. two routing nuances: if a user redeems >=200 tokens -> auto-create SDR task; if they RSVP to the webinar and are enterprise domain -> create SF opportunity stub.
Sofia Li: experiments: randomize users into three creative arms by subject line + CTA: A: "Try Redwood in one prompt (10 tokens)" B: "Get 40 tokens + interactive demo" C: "Start with 200 tokens and a guided walkthrough". measure lift on demo-run and first-5.
Becky Nguyen: tracking events we need:

```
blog_post_view
interactive_demo_trial_run
credit_claimed_launch
promptpack_installed
first_5_requests
webinar_rsvp
```

Also add property campaign: "interactive-launch-q2" and credit_tier property.
Devon Park: analytics nuance: dedupe by user_id but also capture anonymous demo runs (no-claim) and map when they later claim. we should keep an "anon_cookie_id" property on demo runs.
Omar Khan: creative deliverables: 1 interactive embed dev spec, 3 hero variations, 3 subject lines, 2 in-app modal variants. timeline: spec Mon AM, creative Tue noon, dev embed Thurs AM, soft-launch Fri to 7k seeded users.
Sofia Li: post-launch benchmark doc outline: hypothesis, channel mix, cohort sizes, primary metrics (demo conversion, first-5, 14-day paid conversion), token economics (estimated token cost + infra), latency impact, and recommended next action. include a short section "what surprised us".
Becky Nguyen: cost calc note: token cost per redeemed token = 0.0007 USD, infra uplift 12%, run a sample row for each credit tier.
Devon Park: ops: opening ticket to enable fastpath for campaign cohort, and to ensure model quota is reserved for first 48h. tagging @eng-ml.
mkt-bot: scheduled: post-launch retrospective doc reminder set for 2 weeks after campaign end.
Omar Khan: final: we'll A/B the subject line arms and credit tiers independently so we can measure creative vs incentive. posting checklist to #marketing-prod tonight. Thanks team! :rocket:
